metadata.title: JODHPUR  Food Tour | Part - 2/2 I Rajasthan Food Tour
metadata.description:
In this episode of Jodhpur Street Food tour, we covered the traditional Rajasthani thali at Gypsy Restaurant. Moving on to try the best chai in town at Bhati Tea Stall. Next, we had the most sought after street food of Jodhpur - Mirchi Vada. 

We tried some unique street dishes like Masala mayonnaise omelette near Ghantaghar, chicken silly - crispy fried chicken, the creation of Al baik and finally Kashmiri chicken which has nothing to do with Kashmiri cuisine at Jammu and Kashmir Hotel near the railway reservation counter. 

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
